# Phase 2 cleaning scorecard (synthetic data)

*Generated by `src/score_cleaning.py` on 14 October 2026. Do not edit by hand.*

Scores the pipeline (`ingest.py` + `clean.py`) against the synthetic answer keys. **Fixed** = the cleaned value equals the true value. **Flagged** = the pipeline marked the cell or row for review. **Missed** = neither.

## Known limitations

- **19 problems in the main set cannot be detected from the files and are excluded** (accepted by the team on 14 October 2026):

| error_type | detail | count |
|---|---|---|
| status_completed_but_late | this file has no planned date, so lateness cannot be seen | 14 |
| transcription_error | name spelling (cannot be detected without the paper form) | 5 |

  The paper activity form should gain a **planned date** field (decision log D56); the misspelt names can only be caught by checking the paper form itself.
- An ID stored as a number in Excel has already lost its 16th digit; it is flagged, but the digit cannot be recovered (D57).
- The synthetic data was written by the same team that wrote the cleaner. The held-out set below is the fairer test; real partner files will be the real one.

### (d) Duplicate beneficiaries: matching threshold

Pairs of registrations of the same person. Precision = share of matched pairs that are right; recall = share of true pairs found. Same national ID = always matched; otherwise names must score at least the threshold, in the same district and of the same sex, and are kept apart if phones differ by more than 1 digit, IDs differ, or ages differ by more than 2 years. ## Held-out set (seed 7919, new mess, pipeline unchanged)

Generated by `config/synthetic_holdout.yaml`: a fifth officer (FO05) with column names the pipeline has never seen, dates such as `12 Mar 24`, new district spellings (`Rurindo`, `Nyag.`, `Butare`), harder duplicates (names swapped between columns, missing letters, nicknames, no phone) and different people who share a name, district and sex. **The cleaner was not changed for this set.**

**The unchanged pipeline crashed on this set.** Error:

```

  File "C:\Users\User\Applied Project\src\score_cleaning.py", line 387, in run_pipeline_on
    clean.run(staging)
  File "C:\Users\User\Applied Project\src\clean.py", line 770, in run

                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'upper'
```

To still score it, the files whose header row the pipeline could not recognise were set aside (SYNTHETIC_activity_monitoring_FO05.xlsx, SYNTHETIC_beneficiary_register_FO05.xlsx) and the run repeated. **Every record in those files counts as missed** and their duplicate pairs stay in the recall denominator, so these results are conservative.

## Flag severity and the monthly review queue (main set)

Each flag has one of three levels (`flag_severity` in config/settings.yaml): **critical** = row quarantined until the source file is corrected; **warning** = row used, but goes to the MEAL officer's review queue; **info** = counted as a data-quality measure, no one acts on a row. A row with any critical flag is quarantined and not also counted in the review queue.

Flags by level: critical 315, warning 331, info 1,568.

### Review queue (warnings) per month

At 2 minutes a row (an assumption to check with the MEAL officer), the budget of 60 minutes a month allows 30 rows.

- Rows to review over 36 months: **240**; per month: average **6.7**, median 6, busiest month 15 (2024-03), about 13 minutes a month on average.
- Months over the one-hour budget: **0**.
- Rows with no month (e.g. donor records): 0.
